passage_en: The shop is open from 10 am to 9 pm on Monday to Saturday. On Sunday it closes early, at 2 pm.
query_code_mixed: Sunday roju shop enni gantalaku close chestaru?

passage_en: Home delivery is free for orders above 500 rupees within 5 km. Below that a delivery charge of 40 rupees applies.
query_code_mixed: Ghar pe home delivery karte ho kya, kitna charge lagta hai?

passage_en: Any item can be returned within 7 days if you bring the bill. Opened food packets are not taken back.
query_code_mixed: Bill unte return cheyochaa, entha rojula lopu?

passage_en: We accept UPI, cash and card. There is no extra charge for paying by card.
query_code_mixed: UPI se payment le lete ho kya, ya sirf cash?

passage_en: A 25 kg bag of sona masoori rice costs 1450 rupees. The 10 kg pack is 620 rupees.
query_code_mixed: Sona masoori rice 25 kg bag rate entha?

passage_en: Mobile phone repairs are returned in two working days. An estimate is given before any work is started.
query_code_mixed: Mobile repair ke liye kitne din lagte hain?

passage_en: Tailoring measurements are taken only between 4 pm and 8 pm, and it is better to take an appointment on the shop number.
query_code_mixed: Tailoring measurement ki appointment kavala, ee time lo?

passage_en: During the Diwali week there is a 10 percent discount on all steel vessels and gift boxes.
query_code_mixed: Diwali pe koi discount offer hai kya vessels pe?

passage_en: Regular customers can keep a monthly credit account and settle the total on the first week of the next month.
query_code_mixed: Monthly credit account pettukovacha, next month settle chesthe saripotunda?

passage_en: Two wheelers can be parked in front of the shop. There is no car parking, the nearest one is in the lane behind.
query_code_mixed: Shop ke bahar scooter parking milegi kya?
